function.name: get_sensor_alerts
function.description: Retrieve a paginated list of sensor alerts within a specified timespan and optionally filtered by various criteria such as network IDs or sensor metrics.

perPage.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 100.

startingAfter.description: A server-generated token indicating the start of the page, such as a timestamp or an ID.

endingBefore.description: A server-generated token indicating the end of the page, such as a timestamp or an ID.

t0.description: The start of the timespan for the data, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). The maximum lookback period is 365 days from today.

t1.description: The end of the timespan for the data, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2023-12-31T23:59:59Z'). t1 can be a maximum of 365 days after t0.

networkId.description: A list of network IDs to filter the returned data.

timespan.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched in seconds. Do not specify if t0 and t1 are provided. Must be less than or equal to 31,536,000 seconds (365 days).

sensorSerial.description: The sensor serial number to filter the returned data.

triggerMetric.description: Filter alerts triggered by a specific metric.

function.name: get_sensor_readings_latest
function.description: Retrieves the most recent readings for each metric from each sensor, organized by the sensor's serial number.

perPage.description: Specifies the number of entries per page. Must be within the range of 3 to 100.

startingAfter.description: The server-generated token marking the start of the page. Typically a timestamp or ID. If omitted, the server will provide the default starting point.

endingBefore.description: The server-generated token marking the end of the page. Typically a timestamp or ID. Optional; if omitted, the server will provide the default ending point.

networkId.description: Filters the returned data by network IDs. If omitted, data for all networks is returned.

serials.description: Filters readings by sensor serial numbers. If omitted, readings for all sensors are returned.

metrics.description: Specifies the types of sensor readings to retrieve, such as 'temperature', 'humidity', or 'co2'. If omitted, all available types of readings are retrieved.

function.name: get_sensor_readings_history_by_interval
function.description: Retrieves historical sensor readings within a specified timespan, summarized in intervals, and returns them sorted by the start time of each interval in descending order.

perPage.description: Number of entries per page, within the range of 3 to 100.

startingAfter.description: Server-generated token indicating the start of the page, typically a timestamp or ID.

endingBefore.description: Server-generated token indicating the end of the page, typically a timestamp or ID.

networkId.description: Filter data by the specified network IDs.

serials.description: Filter readings by sensor serial numbers.

metrics.description: Specify sensor reading types to retrieve, such as 'temperature', 'humidity', 'pressure'. Defaults to all available types if not supplied.

timespan.description: The timespan for fetching data, in seconds. The maximum is equivalent to 730 days and 12 hours.

t0.description: Start of the data timespan, in the ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. The maximum lookback period is 730 days and 12 hours.

t1.description: End of the data timespan, in the ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. This can be a maximum of 730 days and 12 hours after t0.

interval.description: The time interval in seconds for the data returned. Valid values are 15, 120, 300, 900, 3600, 14400, 86400, or 604800.

models.description: Filter readings by one or more sensor models. Available models include 'MT10', 'MT11', 'MT12', 'MT14', 'MT20', 'MT30'.

function.name: get_sensor_readings_history
function.description: Return all reported readings from sensors within a specified timespan, sorted by timestamp. This can include various types of sensor data across different networks and devices.

perPage.description: The number of entries per page returned. Must be within the range of 3 to 100.

startingAfter.description: A server-side token that represents the start of the page, such as a timestamp in the format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. This should not be manually set by the client.

endingBefore.description: A server-side token that represents the end of the page, such as a timestamp in the format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. This should not be manually set by the client.

networkId.description: The network IDs to filter the returned data. If omitted, data from all networks will be included.

serials.description: Sensor serial numbers to filter the readings by. If omitted, readings from all sensors will be included.

metrics.description: Types of sensor readings to retrieve, such as 'temperature', 'humidity', 'co2'. If omitted, all available types will be retrieved.

timespan.description: The duration for which sensor data will be fetched, specified in seconds. Maximum value corresponds to 730 days and 12 hours.

t0.description: The start of the timespan for the data, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. Maximum lookback is 365 days and 6 hours from today.

t1.description: The end of the timespan for the data, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. 't1' can be at most 7 days after 't0'.

function.name: events_api_EventsApi_agent_monitoring_events
function.description: Retrieves all agent monitoring events within a specified timeframe. It allows for querying historical events and can filter events based on their state updates. Users can define the timeframe using 'to', 'from', and 'windowSize' parameters.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp in seconds. If not provided, defaults to the current service time.

_from.description: The start of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp in seconds, defining a range [from, to). This is an alternative to 'windowSize'. If neither 'from' nor 'windowSize' is provided, defaults to 10 minutes before the 'to' timestamp.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds, relative to the 'to' parameter. If neither 'windowSize' nor 'from' is provided, defaults to 600000 milliseconds (10 minutes).

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: Excludes events triggered before the requested timeframe. Useful for integrations that require only new events starting within the timeframe.

filterEventUpdates.description: Filters the results to include only event updates. Events are included only if their state changed within the requested timeframe. Suitable for integrations that are interested in event state updates.

function.name: OpenWeatherMap_get_current_weather
function.description: Fetches the current weather information for a specified location using the OpenWeatherMap API.

location.description: The location for which current weather information is requested, specified in the format of 'City, Country' in English. For example: 'Seoul, South Korea'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather data. Can be 'metric' for Celsius, 'imperial' for Fahrenheit, or 'standard' for Kelvin.

api_key.description: The API key used to authenticate requests to the OpenWeatherMap API. This key should be kept secret.

function.name: ControlAppliance_execute
function.description: This function is designed for controlling a home appliance, checking its current status and settings, as well as monitoring indoor air properties like air quality and temperature. For control commands, the input must clearly specify 'power on' or 'start'. To check the status, the input must include the keyword '확인'. Note that this tool is not intended for describing, creating, deleting, or removing modes or routines.

command.description: The command must be specified as a string in Korean, consisting of the room name, appliance name (or alias), and operation command, separated by commas. Examples: '거실, 에어컨, 실행' for turning on the air conditioner in the living room, ', 에어컨, 냉방 실행' for activating cooling without specifying the room, '다용도실, 통돌이, 중지' for stopping the washing machine (alias '통돌이') in the utility room.

function.name: HNA_NEWS_search
function.description: Searches for recent events and news based on the specified keyword.

keyword.description: The key term used to search for relevant news articles.

category.description: The category to filter news articles by.

date_range.description: The date range for the news search, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD'.

sort_by.description: The sorting order of the search results.

language.description: The language of the news articles to retrieve.

function.name: cookbook_search_recipe
function.description: Searches for cooking recipes based on a provided keyword. Returns a list of recipes that contain the keyword in their title or ingredients list.

keyword.description: The keyword to search for in the recipe titles or ingredients.

cuisine.description: The cuisine type to narrow down the search results.

max_results.description: The maximum number of recipe results to return.

function.name: Restaurants_2_ReserveRestaurant
function.description: Make a table reservation at a specified restaurant for a certain number of guests on a given date and time.

restaurant_name.description: The name of the restaurant where the reservation is to be made.

location.description: The location of the restaurant in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

time.description: The tentative time for the reservation in 24-hour format (e.g., '18:30' for 6:30 PM).

number_of_seats.description: The number of seats to reserve at the restaurant. Must be a positive string.

date.description: The tentative date for the reservation in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today's date if not provided.

function.name: Restaurants_2_FindRestaurants
function.description: Finds restaurants within a specified location and filtered by category, price range, and vegetarian options availability. The search can also be extended to include restaurants with outdoor seating.

category.description: The type of cuisine or food category offered by the restaurant, such as 'Italian', 'Chinese', or 'Vegetarian'.

location.description: The city where the restaurant is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

price_range.description: The price category of the restaurant's offerings. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

has_vegetarian_options.description: Indicates whether the restaurant provides adequate vegetarian options. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

has_seating_outdoors.description: Denotes if the restaurant has outdoor seating available. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.
